description: Java class defining a rule engine node for publishing messages to Azure IoT Hub via MQTT, including initialization, configuration, and upgrade logic.

classes.name: TbAzureIotHubNode
classes.description: A rule engine node for publishing messages to Azure IoT Hub via MQTT, extending TbMqttNode, with configuration, initialization, and upgrade logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, sets MQTT configuration, and creates the Azure MQTT client.

methods.name: prepareMqttClientConfig
methods.description: Prepares MQTT client configuration, setting username and password based on credentials.

methods.name: initAzureClient
methods.description: Creates and returns an MQTT client for Azure IoT Hub.

methods.name: setClock
methods.description: Sets the clock used for SAS token generation, primarily for testing.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles upgrading configuration from older versions, adding protocol version if missing.
